meta.methodology: Uncapped recipient-side itemised party receipts selected by aec_receipt_selection.ReceiptSelection; public funding, government/internal payers, reviewed outliers and nonpositive rows excluded. Donor declarations are never added. Donations count Donation Received only; no loans are inferred.

receipt_types.measure: Recipient-side itemised receipts only. Donor-side declarations are cross-checks, never added. Equal rows within a recipient file are retained as disclosed.
receipt_types.legacy_totals: total, count and byYear are unchanged legacy all-record aggregates. They include donor declarations and must not be used as the typed receipt measure.
receipt_types.fields: by_type contains AUD amounts; by_type_year maps financial year (short form) or election/referendum event to type: [AUD, row count]. Node cells sum visible receipt edges only, unlike legacy party node totals.
receipt_types.normalisation: AEC labels lowercased, punctuation/whitespace replaced with underscores. Donation Received = donation_received. Blank = unknown. Unspecified remains unspecified. No inference of loans from Other Receipt.
receipt_types.scope: Uncapped recipient-side itemised party receipts selected by aec_receipt_selection.ReceiptSelection; public funding, government/internal payers, reviewed outliers and nonpositive rows excluded. Donor declarations are never added. Donations count Donation Received only; no loans are inferred.
receipt_types.selection: aec_receipt_selection.ReceiptSelection.exclusion is shared with the uncapped report: recipient-side positive itemised party receipts, exact recipient mapping, no reviewed outliers, government/party-unit entities or public-funding/party-name donor spellings. Map edge membership is the additional cap. A Public Funding receipt under any other spelling stays as its own public_funding cell, which no portal figure counts; the uncapped report leaves it out.

donor_matching.rule: Annotation-style brackets route to flagged_review. Otherwise existing entity or raw spelling first, then case/punctuation/spacing, then complete bracketed parts removed. State brackets must agree with an alias's state brackets. Each fallback must identify exactly one existing node; state filtering never breaks a node tie. Node identities and map edges are never merged or created.
donor_matching.scope: Eligible recipient-side rows before the map edge cap, plus annotation_review exclusions; [rows, AUD]. Ambiguous and state-mismatched rows remain unmatched.

receipt_types.party_return_note: return_by_type and return_by_type_year on a federal party node count the itemised receipts in the party's own annual returns (AEC Detailed Receipts, Political Party Return), each receipt line once and all receipt types, so a gift the donor also declared is never added twice. A return is counted under the party its name reads as (without a branch label such as ' - NATIONAL') when that party is on the map, otherwise under the existing recipient mapping, so Country Labor Party is counted with Labor and Country Liberal Party (NT) on its own, as the AEC's Party Group has them. Left out: public funding, tax refunds and other government payments (receipt type Public Funding, an electoral commission, funding authority, tax office, department or other government payer by name, or a payer the resolver knows as a government body), blank or non-positive lines, and transfers within the party. Payments made through parliament and council payrolls are counted as receipts: they are most likely members' party levies, the members' own money. A union, or a trades and labour council, is never treated as a government payer or a party branch. The flagged_review outlier list used elsewhere is not applied: on a party's own return it held only public funding and real gifts. A line is a transfer within the party only if the payer's own returns are counted in the same node: the payer is a party unit, the same rule places it in this node, and it is not an associated entity (on the AEC associated-entity register, or a name that lodged an Associated Entity Return, matched without ATF or trustee clauses, punctuation, Holding/Holdings or Pty Ltd differences; without the ext_aec_returns table the deciding names pinned in scripts/aec_associated_entity_names.json are used, and party_return_associated_names says 'pinned'). That money was counted when the paying branch received it, so it is left out rather than keyed; party_return_transfers gives it per party as [AUD, lines]. A payer whose returns are counted in another node, or in none, is counted as a receipt, as are associated entities. Amounts under the disclosure threshold are not itemised by the AEC and are not here, so these figures are well below the AEC's Total Receipts. A node with no counted line has no return fields. Unlike the legacy total, count and byYear, these fields hold no donor-side declarations; unlike by_type on a party node, they are not capped to donors drawn on the map. A renamed party is one node under its current name, its former name's returns included (the Liberal Democratic Party's in the Libertarian Party's), and its return_by_name gives each name's part as {name: [AUD, lines, first financial year, last financial year]}, under the name each return was lodged as.

bracket_aliases.rule: Bracket-bearing canonical source labels fold into one plain base of the same individual/organisation kind. Base ambiguity is never broken by kind, state, year, amount or map membership.
